transcription.provenance: LLM transcription from the Gallica images of BnF fr. 3096 (btv1b9060015d): automatic glyph segmentation and k-NN classification against a hand-labelled sample, every line checked by eye against its strip. The file records the decoded letter of each glyph, not a sign label; no glyph coordinates were kept.
transcription.conventions: Working transcription, line by line. Clear text in plain type; cipher runs are given as the decoded letters in *italics* with glyph notes in {braces} where a reading is uncertain; ◎ marks the large double-circle sign that closes cipher runs; (ɦ) a tall h-like stroke that behaves as a null; · a fragment/noise box. Method: automatic glyph segmentation + k-NN classification (see build notes), every line checked by eye against the line strip.
